prior_summary: Learn a causal blue-attachment latent from qpos/qvel, TCP pose, blue pose and relative motion, inject it into the diffusion U-Net condition, and supervise it from future lift/contact evidence during training.
applicable_conditions: Use when the robot is leaving the red-pad area or is already above/near the blue block with an open or closing gripper, and the state observation includes reliable finger positions, TCP pose and blue block pose in world coordinates.
termination_guidance: Continue until the blue block is visibly carried with the gripper closed and the blue center is lifted well above the table, approximately z greater than 0.20 m or near the observed handoff height around 0.28 m, with small TCP-blue relative motion.
limitations: The model has no explicit inverse kinematics, no image encoder and no recovery behavior for missed grasps or slipped blue blocks. Attachment is a learned latent supervised from demonstrations, not a hard contact detector.

config.relative_feature_design: shared-normalizer observation history plus world-frame TCP-blue, TCP-red, object-goal, drawer-center, finger-width and short-history motion features
config.attachment_target_rule: training-only label from closed fingers, TCP-blue proximity, future blue height increase and stable TCP-blue transform within the sampled future window
